title: Delinquency Timetable Casebook: Overlock and Lien Notice Fees in a Storage Unit Card Catch-Up Charge (Bluegate AutoPay Authorization)
content:
**Rule.** The card catch-up charge on a storage unit agreement under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the lien-process fees as they will stand on the charge day (the day after the handling date): **the overlock fee plus the lien notice fee** where a lien notice fee is posted against the declined due date or the charge day is at least the lien-notice day count after it; **the overlock fee alone** where only an overlock fee is posted or the charge day is at least the overlock day count after it; and **nothing** otherwise. Day counts are calendar days from the declined due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date); posted means a fee entry of that type on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger whose period is the declined due date.

| Unit class | Overlock day count | Overlock fee | Lien-notice day count | Lien notice fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | 10 | $25.00 | 35 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | 10 | $25.00 | 35 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | 10 | $25.00 | 35 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | 10 | $25.00 | 35 | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | 12 | $30.00 | 40 | $55.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | 15 | $30.00 | 45 | $55.00 |

### Casebook (hypothetical, declined due date 1 March, nothing posted unless stated)

1. *Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, handling date 9 March.* Charge day 10 March, 9 days after: under 10, nothing added.
2. *Same unit, handling date 10 March.* Charge day 11 March, 10 days after: overlock tier, $25.00.
3. *Same unit, handling date 4 April.* Charge day 5 April, 35 days after: lien tier, $25.00 plus $45.00, $70.00.
4. *Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault, handling date 14 March.* Charge day 15 March, 14 days after: under its 15-day overlock count, nothing.
5. *Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault, handling date 2 March, overlock fee already posted for 1 March.* Overlock tier, $30.00.
6. *Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault, handling date 5 March, lien notice fee already posted for 1 March.* Lien tier, $30.00 plus $55.00, $85.00.
